      "explanation": "The bundle manifest is treated as trusted input: entry[\"image\"] is joined directly to bundle and read into memory, then passed to create_document.     ,
      "suggestion": "Resolve candidate paths under the bundle root and reject paths that escape it; constrain generated image names to a safe basename and reject conflicting external IDs."

      "title": "Bundle paths permit arbitrary file exfiltration and fixture overwrite"
    },

      "category": "correctness",

      "explanation": "The CLI maps each metric with stats.get without checking for an empty result. If run_eval returns no per-field or list statistics while succeeded is nonzero, current contains None for those metrics and compare_to_baseline silently skips them, allowing the gate to pass despite missing score coverage.",
      "file": "backend/src/fieldwise/cli.py",
      "line": 531,
      "severity": "medium",
      "suggestion": "Require at least one per-field or list statistic, or fail when an expected metric is absent instead of converting it to None.",
      "title": "Missing per-field/list scores silently bypass the gate"
    },

      "explanation": "The scaling denominator is min(width, height), but downscale_jpeg scales against the maximum edge. The integration fixture only covers a below-limit image and does not exercise this path.",
      "file": "backend/src/fieldwise/gate/bundle.py",
      "line": 77,
      "severity": "medium",
      "suggestion": "Scale coordinates using the same longest-edge calculation as downscale_jpeg, or preserve original coordinates together with the original image.",

  "summary": "The change adds a committed, replay-based evaluation gate with a generated bundle and baseline comparison. Its main risks are unvalidated bundle path handling, coordinate corruption for non-square pages, and incomplete metric coverage being accepted as a passing gate."
